style_lock: High-end 3D animated feature film shot, cinematic CGI with physically based materials, volumetric light, shallow depth of field, filmic warm amber and mineral blue-green color grading, rich physical detail, 16:9 widescreen
negative: no text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark, no logo, no UI, no western architecture, no gothic arches, no church bell, no chandeliers, no oil paintings, no church, no cross-guard sword, no katana, no modern museum, no white display panels, no bright ceiling lights, no modern objects, no extra people unless described, no distorted anatomy, no deformed faces, no plastic toy look

chars.curator: the museum curator: a gentle elderly Chinese man with a long white beard and hair tied in a topknot, wearing a dark indigo Hanfu robe with a wide sash
chars.goujian: King Goujian of Yue: a young ancient Chinese king with sharp determined eyes, short black beard, wearing bronze scale armor over a dark red robe and a dark gold cloak
chars.ximeng: Wang Ximeng: an 18-year-old Northern Song painter, slender, with clear bright eyes, hair in a small topknot, wearing a pale blue scholar robe with a white inner collar
chars.musicians: a row of Zhou dynasty court musicians in dark red robes and black lacquer hats, holding wooden mallets
chars.marquis: Marquis Yi of Zeng: a Zhou dynasty nobleman with a short beard, wearing a bronze-decorated ceremonial robe with jade pendants and a tall bronze crown

env.museum: inside a grand traditional Chinese museum at golden hour: dark red lacquered columns with gold leaf capitals, warm volumetric sunbeams through tall lattice windows, polished dark stone floor, glass display cases, drifting dust motes, deep shadows
env.case: a dark traditional Chinese museum gallery with red lacquered columns and tall lattice windows, a single black stone pedestal and glass display case lit by one warm dramatic overhead spotlight, deep shadows, no modern ceiling lights
env.excavation: a 1976 archaeological excavation in Jiangling, Hubei: a Chu tomb pit with earthen walls, a massive wooden coffin emerging from mud, kerosene lanterns, archaeologists in 1970s work clothes and straw hats
env.tomb: inside a freshly opened ancient Chu tomb: damp earthen walls, wooden chambers, lantern light, bronze artifacts emerging from wet earth
env.forge: an ancient Chinese bronze foundry: clay piece-molds lined up, a furnace glowing orange, molten bronze in a crucible, craftsmen in leather aprons and head cloths
env.song_studio: a Northern Song painting studio: rice-paper windows glowing with daylight, inkstones and mineral pigment bowls on a wooden desk, hanging scrolls, a low lacquered table
env.landscape: the living world of a Northern Song blue-green landscape painting: azurite blue and malachite green mountains layered in mist, jade-green rivers, wooden bridges, tiny villages, painted texture with real 3D depth
env.greatwall: epic Northern Song landscape: blue-green mountain ridges, the Great Wall winding over the crests, broad rivers below, golden mist
env.zeng_temple: an ancient Zeng state ancestral temple: a massive three-tier lacquered wooden bell rack, bronze bells, dark red pillars, torchlight and incense smoke
env.archive: an ancient archive room: shelves of bamboo slips, bronze vessels and sealed scrolls, a single oil lamp, warm dusty light

shots.style: cinematic title sequence shot, dark and elegant
shots.subject: A slow majestic opening: in a vast dark museum hall, three spotlights ignite one after another on three glass display cases in the distance, golden dust swirling in the beams; the camera pushes forward slowly through the darkness
shots.camera: very slow steady push-in at eye level
shots.env: a vast dark Chinese museum hall with distant golden lights and deep shadows
shots.ambience: deep low rumble, a distant bronze bell resonance, soft air

shots.subject: A grand museum hall at dawn: sunlight sweeps slowly across the floor from tall windows, dust drifting, and in the far distance three glass cases glow softly; the camera glides forward through the colonnade toward them
shots.camera: slow crane-down glide, revealing the scale of the hall
shots.ambience: quiet museum room tone, soft deep hum, faint morning birds outside

shots.subject: The museum curator walks slowly along the colonnade and stops, hands clasped behind his back, looking calmly toward the glowing display cases, his indigo robe moving gently
shots.camera: slow dolly following him from the side, then easing to a stop
shots.ambience: measured footsteps on stone, quiet room tone

shots.subject: The curator stands in the foreground with one hand gently gesturing toward three distant glass cases where a sword, a scroll and a bell rack glow in their own pools of light; he does not speak
shots.camera: slow push-in past his shoulder toward the cases
shots.ambience: quiet room tone, a soft breath, distant echo

shots.subject: Extreme detail of a glass display case in a dark traditional Chinese museum gallery: reflections of lattice windows slide across the glass, and through the reflection we glimpse an ancient Chinese bronze sword with a dark rhombic-patterned blade and a flat guard lying on black stone inside the case; dust motes suspended in a shaft of warm light
shots.camera: slow rack focus from the glass reflection to the sword inside
shots.ambience: hushed room tone, a faint metallic shimmer

shots.subject: Museum galleries at dawn before opening: a caretaker silhouette in the far distance draws a curtain, and a long blade of sunlight crosses the empty floor toward a distant display case, dust rising
shots.camera: slow lateral pan across the empty gallery
shots.ambience: echoing empty hall, soft cloth and footsteps far away

shots.subject: The Sword of Goujian: an ancient Chinese double-edged bronze sword with a dark grey-green patinated blade densely covered in a fine black rhombic grid pattern, an inlaid gold hilt, and eight bird-seal characters on the guard; it rests on black stone inside a glass display case, and a single spotlight catches its polished edge, glinting coldly after two thousand five hundred years
shots.camera: extremely slow push-in toward the blade
shots.ambience: low room tone, a delicate metallic ring

shots.subject: The 1976 excavation of a Chu tomb at dusk: archaeologists in 1970s work clothes lower a kerosene lantern into a deep muddy pit; the lid of a massive wooden coffin is being lifted as mist drifts over the earth
shots.camera: crane down from the rim of the pit into the excavation
shots.ambience: wind over the dig, scraping earth, hushed voices, a rope creaking

shots.subject: Inside the newly opened tomb, a bronze sword covered in wet earth lies on a wooden tray under lantern light; gloved hands gently brush soil away from the blade, revealing a gleam of bronze
shots.camera: top-down slow push toward the sword
shots.ambience: soft brushing, water dripping, tense silence

shots.subject: Extreme macro of the Sword of Goujian's blade: a dark bronze surface densely covered with a fine black rhombic grid pattern, the polished edge shining silver-bronze against the dark pattern, raking light revealing the ancient forging texture, still almost uncorroded
shots.camera: slow macro glide along the blade edge
shots.ambience: metallic shimmer, barely audible room tone

shots.subject: Extreme close-up of the sword's guard: eight ancient bird-seal characters are inlaid in gold on dark bronze, and the light rakes across them so each stroke flares for a moment; the focus breathes slowly across the inscription
shots.camera: slow orbit with rack focus across the inscriptions
shots.ambience: quiet room tone, a soft metallic whisper

shots.subject: King Goujian kneels on a bed of brushwood in a dark Warring States hall, tasting gall from a small bronze vessel; his eyes are fierce and unbroken, firelight carving his face, his hand gripping the scabbard of a bronze sword
shots.camera: slow push-in from medium to close on his face
shots.env: a dark Warring States hall lit by a single brazier, brushwood on the floor, bronze vessels in shadow
shots.ambience: fire crackle, wind through a wooden hall, a low tense drone

shots.subject: Inside an ancient bronze foundry: molten bronze is poured into clay piece-molds, sparks spiral upward, craftsmen's silhouettes move behind the glow; on a bench, a finished bronze sword cools beside rows of clay molds
shots.camera: slow lateral dolly across the foundry floor, from the pour to the finished blade
shots.ambience: roaring furnace, hissing metal, distant hammer blows

shots.subject: A bronze sword is drawn smoothly from its dark scabbard in a dark room; dust hangs in a single shaft of white light; the blade emerges gleaming, and the last of the scabbard's shadow slides away
shots.camera: slow lateral follow of the blade as it is drawn
shots.env: a dark stone chamber with one shaft of light from above, dust motes in the air
shots.ambience: the long slide of bronze on bronze, a tense low breath

shots.subject: The Sword of Goujian in its glass case; the faint reflection of a young visitor's face is pressed close to the glass, eyes wide, while the ancient blade remains perfectly still in the spotlight
shots.camera: slow orbit around the case with the reflection drifting across the glass
shots.ambience: museum room tone, distant footsteps, a soft breath

shots.subject: A museum gallery changes: one wall of light fades as another section brightens; the camera glides through a doorway from the bronze gallery into a dark gallery where a long horizontal scroll case begins to glow blue-green
shots.camera: smooth steadicam glide through the doorway
shots.env: museum, with a long horizontal scroll display case in the next gallery
shots.ambience: footsteps echo, airy room tone shift

shots.subject: The curator walks slowly down a dark gallery toward a lit horizontal display case where a blue-green landscape scroll glows; his silhouette leads the eye toward the painting
shots.camera: over-the-shoulder follow from behind, slow and steady
shots.ambience: footsteps, room tone, a distant soft chime

shots.subject: In a Northern Song painting studio, an 18-year-old painter in a pale blue robe grinds azurite pigment at a low desk by a rice-paper window; a half-finished blue-green landscape scroll lies open before him, brushes and pigment bowls around
shots.camera: slow orbit around the desk from behind his shoulder to a three-quarter front view
shots.ambience: stone grinding on porcelain, a brush on paper, quiet birds outside

shots.subject: A long handscroll of 'A Thousand Li of Rivers and Mountains' unrolls across a dark table; the camera glides low over the painting as azurite mountains, malachite rivers, villages and bridges fill the frame, then lifts gently to reveal its eleven-meter length
shots.camera: low aerial glide over the unrolling scroll
shots.env: a dim museum studio with the long scroll unrolled under warm lamps
shots.ambience: silk and paper unrolling, a soft airy hum

shots.subject: Macro shot of mineral pigments: chunks of azurite blue and malachite green are ground with a pestle into brilliant powder, the powder glows under a warm light with a thousand-year intensity
shots.camera: extreme macro slow motion around the mortar
shots.env: song_studio, close on the pigment bowls and grinding stone
shots.ambience: grinding stone, fine powder falling, quiet breath

shots.subject: The young painter stands from behind in the studio doorway, brush in hand, looking at his finished blue-green scroll; daylight spills over his shoulders and the painting glows like a window into another world
shots.camera: slow push-in from behind him toward the scroll
shots.ambience: a quiet room, brush resting on porcelain, distant wind

shots.subject: An empty studio at dusk: the finished scroll slowly rolls itself closed on the table, a brush left lying beside the inkstone, dust drifting through the last light; nobody is there
shots.camera: slow crane up from the scroll to the empty room
shots.env: song_studio at dusk, warm fading light
shots.ambience: wind outside, paper curling, a deep quiet

shots.subject: The painter's silhouette bent over the scroll in a candlelit studio, painting with desperate focus; dozens of candles burn around him, blue-green pigment glowing like water, his shadow huge on the wall
shots.camera: slow push through the candle flames toward his silhouette
shots.env: song_studio at night lit by many candles
shots.ambience: candle flames flickering, brush strokes, a quiet tense breath

shots.subject: The camera pushes into the painted surface of the blue-green scroll; the paper texture dissolves into a living 3D world of azurite mountains and jade rivers; a tiny figure in a pale blue robe stands on a painted wooden bridge far ahead
shots.camera: continuous smooth push-in from the painting surface into the landscape world
shots.ambience: wind rising, a distant river, a soft magical shimmer

shots.subject: A living blue-green mountain world: mist drifts between azurite peaks, a jade river carries small boats, and the distant figure in a pale blue robe walks slowly across a wooden bridge, tiny but alive
shots.camera: slow aerial crane over the river toward the bridge
shots.ambience: river flow, wind in pines, distant birds

shots.subject: The Zenghouyi bianzhong: a massive three-tier lacquered wooden rack holding sixty-five bronze bells of different sizes, guarded by bronze warrior supports; in a dark hall, one spotlight finds the bells and the camera cranes up to reveal their overwhelming scale
shots.camera: slow crane up from the base to the top tier
shots.env: a vast dark museum hall containing the full three-tier bell rack
shots.ambience: deep room tone, a faint bronze hum, dust settling

shots.subject: The Zenghouyi bianzhong: a clearly readable three-tier lacquered wooden rack holding sixty-five bronze bells of different sizes, guarded by bronze warrior supports; the camera is at eye level and slowly tracks along the three tiers so the layers are clear, warm torchlight glinting on the bronze, deep shadows around
shots.camera: eye-level lateral tracking dolly along the three tiers, the whole rack structure readable
shots.ambience: metallic hum, soft footsteps, a distant echo

shots.subject: Close-up of a bronze bell: a wooden mallet strikes the center of the bell with a clear tone, then moves to strike the side, producing a different, higher tone; the bronze trembles and dust lifts from the lacquered beam
shots.camera: slow push-in on the bell and mallet, slight macro
shots.ambience: two clear bell tones, one deep and one bright, ringing in a stone hall

shots.subject: A row of Zhou dynasty court musicians in dark red robes raise their wooden mallets and strike the bronze bells in unison; the camera tracks along the row, catching each motion in rhythm
shots.camera: wide lateral dolly along the row from a distance, the musicians read as a moving frieze, faces small
shots.ambience: a full ensemble of bronze bells with long stone-hall reverb

shots.subject: A wide shot of the complete bell ensemble performing in the great temple hall: rows of bells, rows of musicians, torchlight and incense smoke, the air itself seeming to vibrate with sound
shots.camera: very wide slow rising crane shot, the whole hall and the ensemble in frame, figures small
shots.ambience: layered bronze bells and drums, deep hall reverb

shots.subject: Macro shot of the bronze inscription on a bell: ancient Chinese characters are engraved deep into the bronze, and a raking light travels along the lines, revealing the text stroke by stroke
shots.camera: slow glide along the inscription with rack focus
shots.env: zeng_temple, close on the bell surface
shots.ambience: quiet bronze resonance, a soft metallic whisper

shots.subject: A symmetrical composition down the axis of the bell hall: the three-tier bell rack on one side, the row of musicians on the other, distant banners; one deep bell tone rolls through the hall and light ripples subtly across the bronze
shots.camera: wide symmetrical dolly forward, the musicians small in the great hall
shots.ambience: one deep bell tone with a very long reverb, then silence

shots.subject: Golden light floods the dark hall; the bell rack stands silhouetted in the glow, and fine golden particles drift through the air like the sound made visible
shots.camera: slow pull back and rise
shots.ambience: a single resonant bell fading into silence, air moving

shots.subject: The museum at night: the sword, the scroll and the bells glow in three connected galleries; a night guard's silhouette walks slowly through the distant corridor, his footsteps alone in the great silence
shots.camera: slow glide from one case to the next along the gallery
shots.env: museum at night, dim security lights, deep shadows
shots.ambience: night room tone, a distant walkie-talkie click, echoing footsteps

shots.subject: One wide composition linking three illuminated displays: the bronze sword in its case on the left, the blue-green scroll in the center, the three-tier bell rack on the right; the camera moves slowly forward as if reading them from left to right
shots.camera: slow forward dolly across the three displays
shots.env: a vast museum gallery arranged with three illuminated exhibits
shots.ambience: quiet room tone, a soft musical shimmer of air

shots.subject: A slow rack focus across three symbolic details arranged in depth: the cold glint of the sword's edge in the foreground, a fresh blue-green brush stroke on silk in the middle, and the trembling surface of a struck bell in the distance
shots.camera: very slow rack focus from foreground to background
shots.env: a dark studio-museum with the three artifacts arranged at different depths, single warm light
shots.ambience: three subtle textures of sound: metal, brush, bronze hum

shots.subject: Extreme macro of the Sword of Goujian's blade: the dark rhombic grid pattern is revealed as countless fine hammered layers, faint forging lines and heat colors shimmering along the dark bronze like a frozen storm
shots.camera: extreme macro drift along the blade surface
shots.env: case with a single raking light
shots.ambience: distant hammer blows, metallic whisper

shots.subject: An archive table lit by one lamp: a bronze sword lies beside a bundle of ancient bamboo slips; a scholar's hand in a dark brown sleeve rests gently on the slips, as if connecting the weapon to its written history
shots.camera: top-down slow push across the table
shots.ambience: paper and bamboo rustle, a quiet room, a far-off temple bell

shots.subject: Inside the living blue-green painting: ancient pines of many different shapes stand along a mountain ridge, each silhouette unique; mist moves between them, and the camera drifts slowly past the trees
shots.camera: slow lateral drift past the pines with gentle parallax
shots.env: landscape, a pine ridge high above the mist
shots.ambience: wind in pine needles, distant valley air

shots.subject: An epic azurite-green vista: layered mountain ridges fade into golden mist, rivers snake through the valleys, tiny villages and stone bridges dot the landscape; the whole painted world breathes
shots.camera: slow high-altitude glide across the landscape
shots.ambience: high wind, distant water, a sense of vast space

shots.subject: Extreme close-up of an 18-year-old painter's hands in pale blue sleeves: one hand steadies the silk scroll, the other holds a fine brush as it lays down a single stroke of azurite blue; a pigment bowl glows beside the hand and candlelight trembles on the silk; the face is out of frame
shots.camera: intimate close-up, slow push from hands to eyes
shots.ambience: a held breath, brush touching silk, candle flame

shots.subject: The 1978 excavation of the tomb of Marquis Yi of Zeng: the great three-tier bell rack still stands upright in the muddy pit, bronze bells hanging in place as if the concert had just ended; lantern light moves across the wet bronze while archaeologists stand in awe
shots.camera: slow crane up from the bells to the rim of the pit and the darkening sky
shots.env: an excavation pit at dusk, muddy walls, the intact bell rack
shots.ambience: wind, dripping water, hushed voices, a faint bronze resonance

shots.subject: Aerial diagonal view of the complete three-tier bell rack: sixty-five bronze bells in perfect order from the largest to the smallest, lacquered beams and bronze warriors holding the structure, dust in the spotlight
shots.camera: slow rotating overhead crane around the rack
shots.env: a dark museum hall with the full bell rack under one great spotlight
shots.ambience: deep silence with a faint metallic hum

shots.subject: In the ancient foundry, molten bronze is poured in a glowing stream into a clay bell mold; sparks burst upward and the bronze bubbles and settles into the shape of a bell
shots.camera: slow-motion close-up of the pour
shots.ambience: the roar and hiss of molten metal, spark crackle

shots.subject: The three exhibits reflected in a dark polished floor: sword, scroll and bells stand in their pools of light while a slow shadow of a passing visitor glides across the reflections
shots.camera: slow pull back along the floor level
shots.env: museum at night, polished black floor, three lit displays
shots.ambience: deep room tone, a distant echo of footsteps

shots.subject: A small crowd of museum visitors seen from behind stands before the three illuminated displays; their faces are out of frame, only silhouettes of heads and shoulders, and their stillness conveys quiet awe
shots.camera: slow push-in from behind the crowd toward the displays
shots.env: museum during visiting hours, warm light
shots.ambience: hushed crowd, soft footsteps, a child whispering

shots.subject: An elegant composition of the three artifacts in one frame: the bronze sword, the blue-green scroll and a single bronze bell, each in its own pool of warm light with dark space between them; the glass reflects a faint young face
shots.camera: slow orbit around the composition
shots.env: a dark exhibition room with three separate spotlights
shots.ambience: quiet room tone, a soft metallic shimmer

shots.subject: Extreme macro of a tiny nick on the Sword of Goujian's edge: a single hair-fine notch in the dark bronze blade surrounded by the fine rhombic grid pattern, raking light revealing it like a scar from a distant battle
shots.camera: slow ultra-macro crawl along the blade edge
shots.ambience: a metallic whisper, then a distant echo of war drums fading

shots.subject: A dim museum storage room: bronze patina blooms green on a vessel, old paper yellows at the edges of a scroll, dust lies thick on shelves; one warm lamp reveals the beauty in decay
shots.camera: slow lateral pan across the shelves
shots.env: a dark museum archive storage with shelves and covered artifacts
shots.ambience: quiet storage room, soft air, a distant clock ticking

shots.subject: At dawn, a vast blue-green mountain ridge emerges from mist; a small figure in a pale blue robe walks slowly along the ridge, far away, and the camera pulls back until the landscape fills the world
shots.camera: slow high aerial pull-back from the lone figure
shots.env: landscape at dawn, azurite mountains, golden mist
shots.ambience: high wind, birds waking, a soft distant river

shots.subject: In the dark bell hall, a single bronze bell is struck; visible waves of air and light expand outward from it through the hall, and dust lifts in a slow halo around the bell
shots.camera: slow push toward the ringing bell
shots.env: zeng_temple in darkness, one bell lit
shots.ambience: one deep bell tone with an enormous reverb, then its decay

shots.subject: The curator stands quietly before the three illuminated cases; his white beard and dark robe are reflected in the glass alongside the visitors behind him; golden hour light crosses the gallery
shots.camera: slow lateral dolly past him, catching his reflection
shots.ambience: room tone, hushed footsteps, a calm breath

shots.subject: The three displays glow in the darkness like constellations; the camera cranes up and back to reveal the whole gallery, each case a warm point of light in the vast dark
shots.camera: slow crane up and back, wide reveal
shots.env: a vast dark museum hall with three glowing displays
shots.ambience: warm room tone, a faint distant chime

shots.subject: A single visitor stands motionless before a display case, fully absorbed; other visitors pass behind as soft motion blur, and the still figure becomes the only sharp thing in the world
shots.camera: slow push-in on the standing visitor from behind
shots.env: museum during visiting hours, motion blur crowds
shots.ambience: soft crowd murmur, footsteps fading

shots.subject: Close on the ancient bronze sword's polished edge serving as a dark mirror: the reflection of a modern visitor's face slowly shifts into the reflection of an ancient king in bronze armor, then returns to the present, and the dark bronze catches a final glint
shots.camera: very slow push-in on the blade surface
shots.env: case, close on the blade acting as a dark mirror
shots.ambience: a metallic shimmer, distant war drums rising and fading into silence

shots.style: cinematic end title shot, dark and elegant
shots.subject: The lights of a dark traditional Chinese museum hall dim one by one; only a single Chinese bianzhong bronze bell (almond-shaped body, flat mouth, suspended from a dark lacquered wooden beam) remains silhouetted in one last warm spotlight, and fine golden dust drifts down through the beam before the screen falls into darkness
shots.camera: very slow pull-back into darkness
shots.env: a dark traditional Chinese museum hall with red lacquered columns, one last warm spotlight, deep shadows, no church, no chandelier
shots.ambience: a single bell tone decaying into deep silence
